;Politics and elections
*[[United States federal government shutdown of 2013]]:
**[[United States|U.S.]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Barack Obama]], the [[White House]] [[Office of Management and Budget]], issues a partial shutdown of government agencies after the [[United States Congress|House]] and [[United States Senate|Senate]] fail to come to an agreement on a spending bill to keep government operations running. [http://nbcpolitics.nbcnews.com/_news/2013/09/29/20743313-chances-of-averting-government-shutdown-appear-slim?lite (NBC News)]
